conventions.si_mapping: '4.1': si := raw_intensity of kala_gochara_windows, exactly as stored (the unsigned magnitude) — SI addendum v1.4 §1a. NOT signed_intensity: the 4.x writer stores signed_intensity = raw_intensity x (-1 if is_adverse else 1), negative on every adverse window, which protocol §4.5 rejects. Like-for-like with '3.0': in generation '3.0' signed_intensity == raw_intensity on all 914 rows (none negative; 330 adverse rows positive), so the pinned '3.0' si is the same quantity. The extract command stops if any row has |signed_intensity| != raw_intensity or raw_intensity < 0. raw_intensity is NOT NULL, so no unknown competitor can occur in a '4.1' extract: the run asserts unknown_si_rows = 0 and discloses any other value. The governed-5.x mapping (si := evidence_for) is untouched.
conventions.utc_to_ist: dates converted to IST civil dates via (ts at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date, applied in the extract SQL (services/gochara_eval/dump_extract.py SQL_DUMP)
conventions.merge_implementation: services/gochara_eval/candidate.py merge_candidates — protocol §4.2: overlapping/abutting same-class windows (we+1 day >= next ws) merged; representative = max si, ties (|Δ|<=1e-9) -> earliest peak; a group with any unknown member has an unqualified representative
conventions.stored_value_precision: si read as NUMERIC and converted to IEEE double via Decimal->float; JSON serialised with Python's shortest round-trip repr; dates ISO yyyy-mm-dd
conventions.tie_grouping: adjacent-gap (a chain of values each < 1e-9 from its neighbour is one group) for BOTH ranking and the §8.3 plateau test — SI addendum v1.3 §4. NOTE: services/gochara_eval/metrics.py event_hit anchors ranking ties on the target value; the two differ only when >= 3 values chain within tolerance (disclosed; pinned in tests/l3/gochara_eval/test_candidate.py).
conventions.candidate_set: protocol §4.6: merged windows of the event's class overlapping the calendar years its scored span touches, clipped to the observation mask [1998-01-01, 2026-04-17]; ONE set for N, hit and rank

horizon.extract_assertion: no '4.1' window outside 1998-01-01 <= window < 2026-04-18 (end-exclusive); the dump stops (INPUT_REJECTED) on violation

thresholds.t_time: capped (182 d) median <= 45 d over the 5 exact events; misses counted at the cap, uncapped hits disclosed; an unqualified peak gives the range [0,182] and cannot pass
thresholds.t_rank: median rank percentile <= 25 with >= 17 of 32 timing-usable eligible, else rank-unproven (blocks flip); VOID on era-fingerprint >= 50 %; eligibility reduced (never floor relaxed) by non-invariant plateau verdicts
thresholds.t_fp_adverse: per adverse class: admitted day-fraction <= min(1, 3*n_c*90/H) (n_c=0 -> allowance of n_c=1)
thresholds.t_fp_gain: every non-adverse non-birth_anchor class with rows: 0.5 % - 40 % of horizon days

requalification_before_extract.expect: T-cover 32/47 (same 15 misses); T-time 182 d (2 misses; uncapped 686/998/333); T-rank VOID 0/32; T-FP 8/9 adverse FAIL + 17/17 gain FAIL; controls 638/940 — every figure of rerun_result_v2_3.json; re-run on the FROZEN code immediately before extract generation, STOP if any differs (the adapter, not '4.1', is then the suspect)

rerun_policy: The scorer is deterministic: a same-input rerun must reproduce the result file byte for byte (checked once, recorded). INPUT_REJECTED / controls rejection / source-reconciliation halt write the partial result and stop — that is a report, not a failure of procedure, and is not retried by editing inputs. After any candidate result has been inspected NO frozen item may change; a change is a protocol violation and is disclosed as one (addendum §5). A discovered defect in the adapter/scorer is reported and fixed in a new, separately-dated freeze, never patched into this run.
